Mary - Album 1: Bloodlines

Who Are You

"Who are you? What happened here?"

Musical direction: urgent ensemble-feeling skate-punk performed entirely in Mary’s voice; overlapping rhythmic lines, fast bass and clipped guitars for the chaotic introductions/questions, emotional lift for Mary/Wendy reunion, darker strings under Hansel’s silence, then everything drops out for the final father reveal.

[Intro — rain / broken window / everyone talking at once]

“Mary?”

Wendy?

“Who’s bleeding?”

“Is that the monster?”

Monster?!

“I said animal.”

“You saw an animal?!”

Can everybody—

WAIT.

[Verse 1]
Ten years gone and Wendy’s standing
Dripping rain across my floor
Beside a girl I’ve never met
Who’s staring at the broken door

Hansel barely staying conscious
Blood across his hands and clothes

And apparently introductions
Are important now.

Who knows.

[Spoken — rapid fire]

Wendy—

Mary.

Obviously.

I know.

I mean—

It’s good to see you.

“You too.”

Really good.

“Really?”

YES.

…

Who’s she?

“Karina.”

Hi!

She waves.

Far too cheerfully.

“And him?”

Hansel.

Karina’s eyes widen.

“Ohhh.”

What does ohhh mean?

“Nothing.”

Wendy says

“It didn’t sound like nothing.”

THANK YOU.

[Chorus]
Who are you?
What happened here?
Why is there blood everywhere?

Why’s the window shattered open?
Why are pieces in your hair?

Who are you?
What did I see?
What came crashing through tonight?

Everybody has a question

Nobody has an answer right

[Verse 2]

Wendy grabs my shoulders.

“Start again.”

Okay.

Something broke through the window.

Karina asks

“What kind of something?”

I DON’T KNOW.

Hair.

Wendy asked

“Hair?”

Fur.

Maybe.

Karina asked

“FUR?”

Please stop enjoying this.

“I’m not!”

You absolutely are.

[Pre-Chorus — overlapping rhythm]

Dog?

Maybe.

Bear?

Maybe.

Wolf?

I—

Karina gasps.

“WEREWOLF?”

Wendy responds

“No.”

Karina says

“You weren’t here.”

Wendy replies

“Neither were you.”

Karina says

“Exactly. Equal evidence.”

That is not—

Wendy stops.

Looks at me.

“Mary.”

What?

“You really think it was an animal?”

…

Yes.

I think.

I know what I—

…

I don’t know.

[Chorus — heavier]
Who are you?
What did I see?
Something moving in the dark

Hair or fur
A growl
A shadow
Then the lights came on—

Hansel.

Who are you?
What happened here?
Why won’t any pieces fit?

Every answer makes a question

Every question changes it

[Verse 3 — music softens]

Then Wendy smiles.

Actually smiles.

And suddenly she’s twelve again
Arguing at our kitchen table

Ten years disappears between us
Just for half a second

I want to ask a thousand things

Where did you go?
How’s your family?
Why now?
Why tonight?

She laughs.

“Still asking seventeen questions at once?”

…

Maybe.

“You haven’t changed.”

Neither have you.

“That is demonstrably false.”

Oh.

There she is.

[Bridge — Karina interrupts]

“So you’re the monster nerd?”

…

Excuse me?

Wendy points at Karina.

“She likes monsters.”

Karina points at me.

“You like monsters.”

I look at Wendy.

You brought me one?

“I regret everything.”

Karina says

“We are going to be friends.”

That is alarmingly confident.

[Beat — Hansel moves]

Hansel groans.

Everything stops.

[Verse 4 — low strings / rain]

Hansel.

Hey.

Stay awake.

His eyes find mine
Then Wendy
Then Karina

Confusion.

Pain.

I kneel beside him.

What happened?

Nothing.

Hansel—

Why are your clothes torn?

Silence.

Whose blood is this?

His breathing changes.

Hansel.

Look at me.

What came through that window?

[Build]

“I…”

What?

“I can’t.”

Can’t what?

“Answer.”

Why?

He shuts his eyes.

I don’t know if he means

He won’t

He can’t

Or he doesn’t know

And somehow that scares me
More than any answer could.

[Final Chorus — full lift]
Who are you?
Who am I missing?
What is hiding underneath?

What came through my broken window?
Why was there blood upon your teeth?

Who are you?
What do you know?
What are you afraid to say?

One night turned every story
I have ever loved

The wrong way

Wendy came back

Karina appeared

Hansel fell out of the dark

And every question I have carried

Just became another mark

[Outro — library door opens]

[DOOR CREAKS]

All four of us turn.

A man stands in the entrance.

Rain behind him.

Calm.

Like the broken glass
The blood
The impossible night

Mean absolutely nothing.

He looks past all of us.

Straight at Hansel.

Then smiles.

“There you are, my son.”

…

Silence.

I look at Hansel.

Hansel looks at him.

“Father?”

[CUT]

TITLE NOTE — STRUCTURAL / FORESHADOWING:
“Who Are You” foregrounds WHO as an explicit mystery variable in the album finale. It does not resolve Hansel, his father, the creature/event at the library, or any supernatural identity. Hansel’s “I can’t answer” remains deliberately ambiguous: unable, unwilling, or genuinely not knowing are all still OPEN.
